  const N      = 24;                 // base pairs

  const RISE   = 60;                 // axial rise per bp
  const R      = 100;                // helix radius
  const HALF   = (N - 1) / 2;
  const CAM    = 1900;               // camera distance (perspective)
  const NODE_R = 9;                  // node radius, world units
  const SUB    = 6;                  // curve subdivisions per bp

  const GAP    = 0.44;               // rung halves stop short of the axis → base-pair gap

  let rot = -0.85, velRot = 0;
  let tilt = 0.34, tiltT = 0.34;
  let zoom = reduceMotion ? 1 : 0.9, zoomT = 1;

  let dragging = false, lastX = 0, lastY = 0;
  let ct = 1, st = 0, fEff = 1, maxAbs = 1;

  let pinchD = 0;
  let last = performance.now(), t0 = last, lastRead = -1e9;

  const lerp  = (a, b, t) => a + (b - a) * t;
  const clamp = (v, a, b) => v < a ? a : v > b ? b : v;

  /* ---- static background plate: vignette + grain + figure frame ---- */
  function buildBg() {
    bg = document.createElement('canvas');
    bg.width = W * DPR; bg.height = H * DPR;
    const b = bg.getContext('2d');
    b.setTransform(DPR, 0, 0, DPR, 0, 0);

    const g = b.createRadialGradient(cx, cy, 0, cx, cy, Math.max(W, H) * 0.72);

    g.addColorStop(0.55, '#0b0f16');
    g.addColorStop(1, '#05070b');
    b.fillStyle = g;
    b.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

    /* fine grain to break up banding */
    const n = document.createElement('canvas');
    n.width = n.height = 140;
    const nc = n.getContext('2d');
    const id = nc.createImageData(140, 140);
    for (let i = 0; i < id.data.length; i += 4) {

      id.data[i] = id.data[i + 1] = id.data[i + 2] = v;

    b.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

    b.lineWidth = 1;
    b.strokeStyle = 'rgba(233,227,216,.09)';
    b.strokeRect(m, m, W - 2 * m, H - 2 * m);
    b.strokeStyle = 'rgba(233,227,216,.38)';
    const L = 13, x0 = m - 0.5, x1 = W - m + 0.5, y0 = m - 0.5, y1 = H - m + 0.5;
    b.beginPath();
    b.moveTo(x0, y0 + L); b.lineTo(x0, y0); b.lineTo(x0 + L, y0);
    b.moveTo(x1 - L, y0); b.lineTo(x1, y0); b.lineTo(x1, y0 + L);

    b.moveTo(x0 + L, y1); b.lineTo(x0, y1); b.lineTo(x0, y1 - L);

    W = innerWidth; H = innerHeight;
    cv.width = W * DPR; cv.height = H * DPR;
    ctx.setTransform(DPR, 0, 0, DPR, 0, 0);

    cx = W * 0.5;
    cy = H * (small ? 0.56 : 0.52);
    const worldH = (N - 1) * RISE + 4 * NODE_R;
    fit = Math.min((H * (small ? 0.58 : 0.72)) / worldH, (W * 0.5 - 70) / (R * 1.6));
    buildBg();

  /* ---- projection: helix-local → tilt → perspective → screen ---- */
  function proj(a, hy, rad = R) {
    const hx = Math.cos(a) * rad, hz = Math.sin(a) * rad;
    const y = hy * ct - hz * st;
    const z = hy * st + hz * ct;          // larger z = closer to viewer
    const p = CAM / (CAM + z);
    const f = clamp(0.5 + z / (2 * maxAbs), 0, 1);   // frontness 0..1

  function frame(now) {

    last = now;

    /* eased state */
    tilt += (tiltT - tilt) * (1 - Math.exp(-dt * 9));
    zoom += (zoomT - zoom) * (1 - Math.exp(-dt * 9));

      velRot *= Math.exp(-dt * 2.6);

    const ease = reduceMotion ? 1 : 1 - Math.pow(1 - clamp((now - t0) / 1100, 0, 1), 3);
    ctx.globalAlpha = ease;
    ctx.drawImage(bg, 0, 0, W, H);

    /* ---- collect depth-sorted draw items ---- */
    const items = [];
    const total = (N - 1) * SUB;

      let prev = null;
      for (let j = 0; j <= total; j++) {

        if (prev) items.push({
          k: 0, s,
          x1: prev.x, y1: prev.y, x2: pt.x, y2: pt.y,
          z: (prev.z + pt.z) / 2, f: (prev.f + pt.f) / 2, p: (prev.p + pt.p) / 2

        prev = pt;
      }

    for (let i = 0; i < N; i++) {
      for (let s = 0; s < 2; s++) {
        const pt = proj(rot + i * TWIST + s * Math.PI, (i - HALF) * RISE);
        items.push({ k: 1, s, x: pt.x, y: pt.y, z: pt.z + 0.6, f: pt.f, p: pt.p });
      }

    for (let i = 0; i < N; i++) {

      const A  = proj(a, hy);
      const B  = proj(a + Math.PI, hy);
      const M1 = proj(a, hy, R * (1 - GAP * 2) * 0.5 + R * 0.12 - R * 0.12); // radius R*(1-2*GAP)+... keep simple below

      const rIn = R * (1 - 2 * GAP);
      const P1 = proj(a, hy, rIn);
      const P2 = proj(a + Math.PI, hy, rIn);
      items.push({ k: 2, s: 0, x1: A.x, y1: A.y, x2: P1.x, y2: P1.y, z: (A.z + P1.z) / 2 - 2, f: (A.f + P1.f) / 2, p: (A.p + P1.p) / 2 });
      items.push({ k: 2, s: 1, x1: B.x, y1: B.y, x2: P2.x, y2: P2.y, z: (B.z + P2.z) / 2 - 2, f: (B.f + P2.f) / 2, p: (B.p + P2.p) / 2 });

    const ax = [];

      const hy = (i - HALF) * RISE;
      const p = CAM / (CAM + hy * st);
      ax.push({ x: cx, y: cy + hy * ct * fEff * p, z: hy * st });

    for (let i = 0; i < N - 1; i += 2) {
      items.push({ k: 4, s: 0, x1: ax[i].x, y1: ax[i].y, x2: ax[i + 1].x, y2: ax[i + 1].y,
                   z: (ax[i].z + ax[i + 1].z) / 2, f: 0.5, p: 1 });

    /* 5′ / 3′ end labels — antiparallel, they fade and drift as the ends rotate */
    const ends = [
      { i: 0,     s: 0, txt: '5\u2032' }, { i: N - 1, s: 0, txt: '3\u2032' },
      { i: 0,     s: 1, txt: '3\u2032' }, { i: N - 1, s: 1, txt: '5\u2032' }
    ];
    for (const e of ends) {
      const pt = proj(rot + e.i * TWIST + e.s * Math.PI, (e.i - HALF) * RISE);
      let dx = pt.x - ax[e.i].x, dy = pt.y - ax[e.i].y;
      const dl = Math.hypot(dx, dy) || 1; dx /= dl; dy /= dl;
      items.push({ k: 5, s: e.s, txt: e.txt, x: pt.x + dx * 16, y: pt.y + dy * 16, z: pt.z + 0.8, f: pt.f, p: pt.p });

      const f = it.f, hue = HUE[it.s];

          ctx.lineWidth = 2.1 * it.p * (0.7 + 0.5 * f);
          ctx.globalAlpha = ease * lerp(0.35, 1, f);
          ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(it.x1, it.y1); ctx.lineTo(it.x2, it.y2); ctx.stroke();

        case 1: { /* node: soft bead + lit core */
          const r = NODE_R * fEff * it.p;
          ctx.globalAlpha = ease * (0.10 + 0.12 * f);
          ctx.fillStyle = `hsl(${hue}, 60%, 62%)`;
          ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(it.x, it.y, r * 2.1, 0, TAU); ctx.fill();
          ctx.globalAlpha = ease * lerp(0.45, 1, f);
          ctx.fillStyle = `hsl(${hue}, ${lerp(42, 68, f) | 0}%, ${lerp(38, 70, f) | 0}%)`;

        case 2:  /* rung half — desaturated tint of its own strand */
          ctx.strokeStyle = `hsl(${hue}, ${lerp(10, 20, f) | 0}%, ${lerp(30, 58, f) | 0}%)`;
          ctx.lineWidth = 1.5 * it.p;
          ctx.globalAlpha = ease * lerp(0.30, 0.9, f);
          ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(it.x1, it.y1); ctx.lineTo(it.x2, it.y2); ctx.stroke();
          break;
        case 3:  /* base bead at the rung tip */
          ctx.globalAlpha = ease * lerp(0.35, 0.95, f);
          ctx.fillStyle = `hsl(${hue}, ${lerp(24, 40, f) | 0}%, ${lerp(42, 72, f) | 0}%)`;
          ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(it.x, it.y, 1.7 * it.p, 0, TAU); ctx.fill();
          break;
        case 4:  /* axis dash */
          ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(233,227,216,1)';
          ctx.lineWidth = 1;
          ctx.globalAlpha = ease * 0.10;
          ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(it.x1, it.y1); ctx.lineTo(it.x2, it.y2); ctx.stroke();
          break;
        case 5:  /* end label */
          ctx.font = '11px ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace';
          ctx.textAlign = 'center'; ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
          ctx.globalAlpha = ease * lerp(0.35, 1, f);
          ctx.fillStyle = `hsl(${hue}, 55%, ${lerp(48, 74, f) | 0}%)`;
          ctx.fillText(it.txt, it.x, it.y);
          break;
      }
    }
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;

    /* instrument readouts, throttled */
    if (now - lastRead > 120) {
      lastRead = now;
      const deg = ((rot * 180 / Math.PI) % 360 + 360) % 360;
      rRot.textContent  = deg.toFixed(1).padStart(5, '0') + '\u00B0';
      rTilt.textContent = (tilt >= 0 ? '+' : '\u2212') + Math.abs(tilt * 180 / Math.PI).toFixed(1) + '\u00B0';
      rZoom.textContent = zoom.toFixed(2) + '\u00D7';
    }

    requestAnimationFrame(frame);
  }

  /* ---- interaction: drag = spin + tilt with inertia, wheel / pinch = zoom ---- */
  cv.addEventListener('pointerdown', e => {
    cv.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId);
    pointers.set(e.pointerId, { x: e.clientX, y: e.clientY });
    if (pointers.size === 1) {
      dragging = true; lastX = e.clientX; lastY = e.clientY; velRot = 0;
      cv.classList.add('dragging');
    } else if (pointers.size === 2) {
      dragging = false;
      const [a, b] = [...pointers.values()];
      pinchD = Math.hypot(a.x - b.x, a.y - b.y);
    }
    hint.classList.add('off');
  });

  cv.addEventListener('pointermove', e => {
    if (!pointers.has(e.pointerId)) return;
    pointers.set(e.pointerId, { x: e.clientX, y: e.clientY });
    if (pointers.size === 2) {
      const [a, b] = [...pointers.values()];
      const d = Math.hypot(a.x - b.x, a.y - b.y);
      if (pinchD > 0) zoomT = clamp(zoomT * d / pinchD, 0.55, 2.1);
      pinchD = d;
      return;
    }
    if (!dragging) return;
    const dx = e.clientX - lastX, dy = e.clientY - lastY;
    lastX = e.clientX; lastY = e.clientY;
    rot += dx * 0.006;
    velRot = clamp(dx * 0.006 * 60, -6, 6);      // flick → momentum
    tiltT = clamp(tiltT + dy * 0.005, -1.15, 1.15); // tip the molecule toward / away
  });

  const release = e => {
    pointers.delete(e.pointerId);
    if (pointers.size < 2) pinchD = 0;
    if (pointers.size === 0) {
      dragging = false;
      cv.classList.remove('dragging');
    } else if (pointers.size === 1) {
      const [p] = [...pointers.values()];
      lastX = p.x; lastY = p.y; dragging = true; velRot = 0;
    }
  };
  cv.addEventListener('pointerup', release);
  cv.addEventListener('pointercancel', release);

  cv.addEventListener('wheel', e => {
    e.preventDefault();
    zoomT = clamp(zoomT * Math.exp(-e.deltaY * 0.0011), 0.55, 2.1);
    hint.classList.add('off');
  }, { passive: false });

  cv.addEventListener('contextmenu', e => e.preventDefault());
  setTimeout(() => hint.classList.add('off'), 14000);

  addEventListener('resize', resize);
  resize();
  requestAnimationFrame(frame);
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>
```

**How it works, briefly:**

- **Geometry** — 24 base pairs with the true B-DNA twist (2π/10.5 rad per bp). Each node lives at `(cos a · R, rise·i, sin a · R)`; strand II is the same points shifted π. A tilt rotation followed by a perspective divide (`p = CAM/(CAM+z)`) projects everything to screen.
- **Correct 3D occlusion** — instead of drawing each strand as one polyline, every strand sub-segment, rung half, node, axis dash and label becomes an item with its own depth, and the whole list is painter-sorted each frame. When one strand passes behind the other, it's genuinely hidden.
- **Depth cueing** — frontness drives lightness, saturation, line width, node size and alpha, so the far side recedes naturally; rungs are desaturated two-tone halves that stop short of the axis, leaving the base-pair gap with small "base" beads at the tips.
- **Interaction** — drag horizontally to spin (with flick inertia and damping), vertically to tip the molecule — tilt it far enough and you look straight down the helical axis, where rungs collapse into diameters. Wheel/pinch zooms; idle auto-rotation resumes gently. `prefers-reduced-motion` disables the autonomous motion.
- **Presentation** — a quiet "scientific plate" framing: hairline frame with corner ticks, film grain over a vignetted near-black field, Georgia-italic figure title, live mono readouts (azimuth/tilt/zoom), and 5′/3′ end labels that drift and fade as the ends rotate. Everything is computed locally with zero external requests.
